explanation: Merged main (#30-#34) into the bundle-reader branch. From this branch: bundleReader.test.ts pins the writer-to-reader round trip, strict JSONP parsing and registry unit precedence; bundleReaderParity.test.ts pins Node reader labels to loadDatasetMeta for every committed meta.js; agentExport.test.ts reads published bytes through readJsonp and asserts the reviewed GSE174085 label. From main: csv.test.ts and csvDownload.ts pin the CSV seam, the hypomap tests cover the co-detection client, expressionSurvey/expressionSurveyLoad tests cover survey derivation, and sourceJson tests cover the expression-source reader.
